Name: FS - Xenoblade Head Wings
Author: tahirah
Description:
A certain character with head wings in Xenoblade Chronicles 3 has a very intense obsession with farming Spongy Spuds, and I decided to create this mod to support my meme potato-only playthrough. The wings are colorable so you can match (or not!) them with your hair color. 

I have no experience with pixel art and based my design on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53858471]Beans[/url] and Maea's beautiful work in their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855]Seasonal Hats[/url] mod. I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108478153]Kailey[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13682]Seasonal Hats for Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ for configuration with Fashion Sense.
